description: This is a Java class file defining a Square object for rendering a 2D square in OpenGL ES 1.0/1.1 within an Android application. It includes buffers for vertex coordinates and draw order, and a draw method using the GL10 context.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: A class representing a 2D square that can be drawn using OpenGL ES. It encapsulates vertex data, drawing order, color, and the draw method.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Constructor that initializes buffers for square vertices and draw order.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Encapsulates OpenGL ES instructions to render the square with the specified color.
